summary: Magnum Ice Cream Co N.V. filed a Form 6-K disclosing a share purchase for long-term incentive plans. The company will enter forward transactions to acquire up to 5.5 million shares, valued at approximately €90 million at current prices, to cover obligations under its employee incentive schemes. Shares will be delivered to the employee benefit trust. This is a routine equity compensation management transaction, not a special situation such as a tender offer, capital return, or issuer tender. No premium, timing, or strategic implications; it is an ordinary corporate housekeeping matter with no advisory roles or risk-arb angle.
